title: TikTok Profile Scraper
description: Collect public TikTok profile metadata and statistics with bounded HTTP sessions and proxy rotation.

usernames.title: TikTok Usernames or Profile URLs
usernames.description: List of TikTok usernames (e.g. scout2015) or full profile URLs. Only public profiles can be scraped.

trackGrowth.title: Track creator growth across runs
trackGrowth.description: Add persistent baseline, updated, unchanged, or partial status plus follower, like, and video deltas. Reuse the same monitor name on scheduled runs.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Stable name for one creator watchlist, such as us-fitness-creators. Histories with different names stay separate.

observationHistoryLimit.title: Observations retained per profile
observationHistoryLimit.description: Bounded private history used to calculate growth velocity and profile changes.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy rotation is recommended for detailed metrics. Public oEmbed metadata is used as a safe fallback when TikTok challenges the profile page.
